name: OMB M-26-14
description: Risk-based agency logging and network visibility for continuous event monitoring and threat hunting, investigation, response, and forensics.

requirements.title: Inventory visibility
requirements.description: Measure the percentage of IT, OT, and IoT assets associated with the system that are represented in a centralized inventory.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use an inventory coverage dashboard or saved search to show the in-scope denominator, covered assets, stale records, and exceptions.
requirements.assessment_method_reference: M-26-14 Appendix C: Inventory Visibility maturity benchmark
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine the percentage of in-scope IT, OT, and IoT assets represented in the centralized inventory.
requirements.applicability: Apply to assets associated with the assessed system and document excluded asset classes or inventory sources.
requirements.pass_criteria: The measured coverage meets or exceeds the selected maturity target, the denominator is documented, and exceptions have owners.
requirements.partial_criteria: Coverage is measurable but below target, the denominator is incomplete, or exceptions lack current ownership.
requirements.fail_criteria: No defensible denominator or current inventory evidence exists, or coverage is materially absent.

requirements.title: Collection coverage
requirements.description: Measure the percentage of inventoried hardware and software assets with required logs searchable and retrievable.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking to show source freshness, CIM or data model coverage, searchable events, and uncovered assets.
requirements.assessment_method_reference: M-26-14 Appendix C: Collection Coverage maturity benchmark
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine the percentage of inventoried hardware and software assets with required logs searchable and retrievable.
requirements.applicability: Apply to every in-scope inventoried asset and identify approved exceptions, collection gaps, and stale telemetry.
requirements.pass_criteria: Coverage meets the selected maturity target and evidence shows current source freshness, searchability, and documented exceptions.
requirements.partial_criteria: Some sources are searchable and measurable, but coverage or freshness is below target.
requirements.fail_criteria: Collection coverage cannot be measured or required sources are not searchable and retrievable.

requirements.title: Collection operations
requirements.description: Measure actionable alert coverage against the minimum baseline logging requirements and document detection tuning.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use a detection coverage dashboard or saved search to show baseline objectives, tested alerts, owners, and tuning exceptions.
requirements.assessment_method_reference: M-26-14 Appendix C: Collection Operations maturity benchmark
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether required logging supports actionable alert coverage and documented detection tuning.
requirements.applicability: Apply to the logging and detection objectives selected for the assessed system, mission, and threat environment.
requirements.pass_criteria: Alert coverage meets the selected maturity target, tests are current, and tuning exceptions have owners and review dates.
requirements.partial_criteria: Alerting exists but coverage, test evidence, or tuning governance is below the target.
requirements.fail_criteria: Required alert objectives are not mapped, tested, or operationally monitored.

requirements.title: Data retention
requirements.description: Verify that logs are searchable and retrievable for the applicable maturity target, with retention evidence separated from searchability evidence.
requirements.source_reference: M-26-14 Appendix B and Appendix C: Data Retention
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the retention policy and use technical evidence to prove searchable duration, retrievable duration, and a completed restore test.
requirements.assessment_method_reference: M-26-14 Appendix B and Appendix C: Data Retention maturity benchmark
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether logs meet the selected searchable and retrievable retention target and can be restored when required.
requirements.applicability: Apply to log stores and archives within the assessed system boundary; distinguish searchable retention from retrievable retention.
requirements.pass_criteria: The applicable maturity target is met, policy and index evidence agree, and a current restore or retrieval test is retained.
requirements.partial_criteria: Retention exists but one duration, archive, restore test, or scope element is below target.
requirements.fail_criteria: Required logs cannot be searched or retrieved for the applicable target, or no defensible retention evidence exists.

requirements.title: Log management
requirements.description: Assess protection of logs in storage and transit, integrity verification, access controls, workload monitoring, and retirement approvals.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the log management policy and technical evidence for protection, integrity, access, monitoring, and retirement controls.
requirements.assessment_method_reference: M-26-14 Appendix C: Log Management maturity benchmark
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether logs are protected, access-controlled, integrity-checked, monitored, and retired through approved gates.
requirements.applicability: Apply to log storage, transport, administration, monitoring, and retirement processes in the assessed boundary.
requirements.pass_criteria: The selected maturity practices are implemented, current evidence covers each applicable area, and exceptions are approved.
requirements.partial_criteria: Some practices operate, but one or more applicable protection, access, integrity, monitoring, or retirement areas remain incomplete.
requirements.fail_criteria: Logs lack required protection or governance, or the organization cannot produce current operating evidence.

requirements.title: Minimum baseline logging
requirements.description: Track whether logging supports identity, network addresses and sessions, object events, privilege changes, infrastructure changes, security tooling, indicators, anomalies, affected data, attack vectors, and automated alerts.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the Agency Logging Plan mapping and technical evidence for each applicable baseline logging objective.
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether the assessed system supports the applicable minimum baseline logging objectives.
requirements.applicability: Apply the baseline objectives relevant to the system, data, mission, and threat environment; document approved exclusions.
requirements.pass_criteria: Each applicable baseline objective has a source mapping, current evidence, and an owner for exceptions.
requirements.partial_criteria: Most applicable objectives are supported but one or more mappings, tests, or evidence records are incomplete.
requirements.fail_criteria: Applicable baseline objectives are not mapped or cannot be demonstrated with current evidence.

requirements.title: Continuous Event Monitoring
requirements.description: Maintain logging and monitoring capabilities that support real-time network activity monitoring, anomaly flagging, and timely response.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the monitoring and response procedures, then inspect current alert, triage, escalation, and response evidence.
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether monitoring supports timely detection, anomaly analysis, and response for the assessed environment.
requirements.applicability: Apply to monitoring capabilities and response workflows supporting the assessed system and mission.
requirements.pass_criteria: Current procedures and operating evidence demonstrate monitoring, analysis, escalation, and timely response.
requirements.partial_criteria: Monitoring exists but analysis, escalation, response timing, or evidence freshness is inconsistent.
requirements.fail_criteria: No reliable continuous monitoring or response evidence exists for the assessed environment.

requirements.title: THIRF capability
requirements.description: Maintain hot and cold storage and the capability to retrieve and centralize logging data for threat hunting, investigation, response, and forensics.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review retention and retrieval procedures, then inspect restore, threat-hunting, investigation, and forensic export evidence.
requirements.assessment_objective: Determine whether hot and cold log storage can support threat hunting, investigation, response, and forensics.
requirements.applicability: Apply to the log stores, archives, retrieval paths, and investigation workflows within the assessed boundary.
requirements.pass_criteria: Required data can be retrieved through tested paths and current evidence demonstrates investigation and forensic support.
requirements.partial_criteria: Retrieval works for some stores or use cases, but cold storage, restore testing, or forensic workflow evidence is incomplete.
requirements.fail_criteria: Required logs cannot be retrieved in a timely, repeatable manner for investigation or forensics.
